claims.claim: Complete engine with compressor and all the operators
claims.evidence: Photos show engine block, harness, intake, throttle body but no clear view of an AC compressor or confirmation of 'all operators' (actuators/sensors); nothing contradicts it either.

claims.claim: Fits Toyota Venza, Camry, Sienna, Highlander
claims.evidence: Witness only read hand-marked 'V6' on the cover; no brand badge, casting number, or VIN/engine tag visible to confirm make or specific applications.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or start
risks.proof: Video clip of cold start with audio, idling steadily

risks.risk: Unknown mileage or engine identification number
risks.proof: Close-up photo of engine block casting number or ID tag

risks.risk: Internal wear, leaks, or compression issues
risks.proof: Compression/leak-down test results or borescope video
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified mechanical condition, worst case

risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos of engine showing all accessory mounts populated
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, missing accessories assumed

risks.risk: Hidden accident, fire, or flood damage
risks.proof: Wide shots of full engine bay removal area and wiring harness ends

risks.risk: No confirmation of actual vehicle fitment (Venza/Camry/Sienna/Highlander)
risks.proof: Photo of engine casting/VIN plate matching known 2GR-FE codes or parts invoice
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified V6, not fitment-guaranteed

proof_requests: Video of engine attempting to start/run
Close-up photo of engine block ID/casting number or any VIN tag
Full walk-around photos showing all sides and accessory mounts (alternator, AC compressor, sensors)
Any compression test or mechanic inspection report
Photo of the vehicle or parts invoice this was pulled from, if available
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used, pulled V6 engine with harness and intake, so it can be priced at worst case (untested, unverified fitment, possible missing parts) while listing proofs that would raise the price.
